description: Subcomponent for `v-stepper-vertical` that represents an individual step item.

props.focusable: Highlights the header when the step is active.

events.click:finish: Event emitted when clicking the finish button
events.click:next: Event emitted when clicking the next button
events.click:prev: Event emitted when clicking the previous button

slots.next: Slot to override the next button
slots.prev: Slot to override the previous button
